title: Optimal Unambiguous Dual-Rail Bell-State Measurement with Linear Optics and Two Ancillary Photons
description: Research package for the theorem that the optimal unambiguous dual-rail Bell-state measurement with static passive linear optics, ideal photon-number-resolving detection, and an arbitrary pure ancilla of exactly two photons has success probability exactly 3/4, with the general fixed-k bound (k+1)/(k+2) attained by the Grice hierarchy at k = 2^N - 2. Contains the manuscript (CC-BY 4.0), exact symbolic verification code with two independent amplitude engines, machine-readable certificates, and a kernel-checked Lean 4 certificate-layer formalization (MIT).
